campaigns.title: Train-first business travel
campaigns.description: Nudge employees toward train routes for regional trips such as Lausanne-Milan, Lausanne-Zurich, and Lausanne-Paris when travel time remains practical.

campaigns.title: Seasonal canteen menu
campaigns.description: Shift company meals and catered events toward seasonal Swiss produce and lower-impact proteins.

campaigns.title: Repair before replacement
campaigns.description: Introduce a repair-first policy for small electronics, office equipment, clothing, and furniture before buying new.

campaigns.title: Second-hand office equipment
campaigns.description: Source selected furniture, monitors, and office items through second-hand or refurbished providers.

campaigns.title: Residual carbon removal
campaigns.description: After reduction actions, estimate residual emissions and connect the company to verified carbon removal options.

partners.name: Train-first travel planning
partners.description: Route employees toward lower-emission train options for regional travel.

partners.name: Repair network
partners.description: Connect employees and offices with repair cafes and repair-first programs.

partners.name: Second-hand procurement
partners.description: Source refurbished or second-hand office equipment and clothing.

partners.name: Carbon removal partner
partners.description: Explore verified carbon removal for hard-to-abate residual emissions.

partners.name: ESG consulting partner
partners.description: Prepare internal ESG summaries or supplier questionnaire responses.
